Priya —

Can do. Quick technical notes (to include in the packet):

- Proof-of-delete export: we can generate a signed CSV that shows tenant_id, object_key (sha256-id), deletion_timestamp (ISO8601), deletion_request_id, and deletion_worker_id. We will redact tenant PII before sending. Example path: s3://redwood-tenant-exports/proof-delete/MDX-2026-1142/2026-09-11/proof-delete.csv.gz (we will sanitize the actual bucket name).

- Logs & snapshots: application debug traces are stored in ephemeral traces indices with a 30-day TTL by default. For Medax tenant we confirmed no extended debug tracing collection was enabled. There is one planned debug session from 2026-07 that produced snapshots retained for 90 days under a temporary canary — we should call this out and offer the compensating controls (audit trail and removal schedule).

- KV cache snapshots: delete flows trigger KV-cache tombstoning and a background compaction that removes keys within 24–72 hours depending on load. We will include a short diagram and timing expectations.

- Keystore/KMS rotation: keys are rotated annually; deletion operations do not rotate keys automatically but we rotate on incident and provide a signed rotation log. Attach keystore-rotation-plan.pdf.

I'll generate the sample CSV and the internal technical note by Monday. Do we want a short signed affidavit from Security? I can draft the technical annex.

— Markus
